reviewed_cause.cause: An atomic child that cannot fit after leading decoration must start in the next fragmentainer. Definite containing boxes retain their own earlier fragments even before that child starts. Source progress for a deferred atomic unit stays bounded by the containing box remaining used size; child ink may overflow that own size. Nested padding and margins contribute to the fragmentainer phase.
